station.title: Scan station
station.subtitle: Scan a parcel to start it, fill it, photograph it and hand it over.
station.idle: Scan a tracking number or an order barcode to begin.

placeholder.tracking: Scan or type a tracking number
placeholder.order: Scan or type an order id

scan.hintTracking: Long codes keep their last {n} characters.
scan.hintOrder: The number printed under the order's QR code.
scan.tooShort: A tracking number is at least 10 characters.
scan.notAnId: An order id is a number.
scan.cancelled: Scan cancelled. No status was changed.
scan.confirmTitle: That is a lot of orders
scan.confirmDesc: This scan will move {count} orders to In production (the threshold is {threshold}).
scan.confirmBody: Nothing has changed yet. Cancel if that count looks wrong — it usually means a mistyped code.

scanned.title: This parcel has been worked already
scanned.desc: {count} of these orders were started before this scan.

group.multiUnit: Multi-unit parcel — count every piece before closing it.

proof.saved: Proof photo saved. The parcel is fulfilled.
proof.overwriteDesc: This parcel already has a photo, or has already been fulfilled.
proof.overwriteBody: The existing photo is the evidence for any dispute about this parcel. Replace it only if the first one was wrong.

handoff.title: Complete handoff
handoff.desc: Type the word completed to confirm the parcel is packed and leaving.

label.title: Link a shipping label
label.desc: Attaches this label and tracking number to all {count} orders in the parcel.

camera.title: Camera
camera.denied: No camera available. The scan box above still works.
camera.tooMany: That code matches too many orders — use the scan box to confirm.
camera.spaceHint: Press Space to capture the proof photo.
camera.scanHint: Point the camera at a barcode to load a parcel.
camera.mirrored: Preview is mirrored, like a mirror. The saved photo is not.

quick.title: Quick scan
quick.subtitle: Scan a parcel and set one status across every order in it.

errors.no-available-basket: No basket position is free. Empty one before continuing.
errors.check-failed: Check failed — type the word again.
errors.not-ready: Every order in this parcel must be fulfilled first.
errors.not-in-production: Scan the parcel before filling it.
errors.amount-exceeds-remaining: That is more than is left to fill.
errors.invalid-transition: That status move is not allowed from here.
errors.not-an-image: Upload a PNG, JPG or WEBP image.
errors.invalid-key: That file could not be stored.
errors.storage-not-configured: File storage is not configured. Tell an administrator.
errors.validation: Check the fields and try again.
errors.provider-unreachable: The carrier did not respond. Nothing was bought — try again.
